decisions.reason: R4 re-called the geometry helper after its R1 parent. It deterministically rewrote nominal qpos/kinematic scratch to the same values, preserving observed end states, but violated the literal shared-state no-store clause. W40 gains4/3 with no extra validation FA make a single causal implementation repair justified. Remove only the redundant scratch stores by reading the current nominal workspace already computed by the parent; do not retune any statistic, threshold, phase or parameter.

CUSUM_ACTIVE and CUSUM_PHASE keep their original diagnostic implementations and are permanently adoption-ineligible for the literal store violation; PHASE also failed normal/outside-event FA, ACTIVE_K05 torque also failed gain/FA. Concentrate the one bounded repair on the simpler W40 which qualified both modes.
